label: sprint goal
definition: The one outcome a sprint commits to, written as the description of the sprint's GitHub milestone. It says why the sprint backlog holds what it holds; the work may change during the sprint, the goal does not.
is_not: The sprint backlog: the backlog is the list of work; the goal is the single outcome that work serves.
An effort's goal: an effort's ## Goal is one unit of work; the sprint goal spans the week.
A milestone title: the title names the sprint; the description holds the goal.
